## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

List the static checks and mocked tests you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves existing runtime behavior unless explicitly stated.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private site details, personal data, or diagnostic payloads are included.
- [ ] Tests do not contact a live GRIT system or actuate physical equipment.
- [ ] Documentation and localization are updated where needed.
